name: 克洛伊·泽图尼安
name_full: 克洛伊·泽图尼安 Chloe Zeitounian
introduction: Chloe Zeitounian was born on the upper east side of New York City, and grew up in Connecticut, New Jersey and Georgia. She made her Broadway debut at just 9 years old, singing a duet alongside rock legend Roger Daltrey.Chloe is a classically trained actor, who attended a 4 year drama program at the University of Georgia, where she earned degrees in drama, opera performance and Spanish. She trained in improv comedy on a talent scholarship at the famed Second City in Chicago.After living in Asheville NC, Blountville TN and Atlanta GA, Chloe now lives in the UK. She has was endorsed as a Global Talent by Arts Council England, while on a UK National tour of Catch Me If You Can alongside Patrick Duffy.She works frequently in television, commercials and films, known for small roles in Silo (Apple TV) John Carpenter's Suburban Screams (NBC), Lovestruck High (Prime Video) and the global Live From PS5 campaign for Playstation5 and Marvel.She works in theatre, television and film, features in print and commercials, and performs as a voiceover artist.Chloe is engaged to Russell Hicks, a stand up comic from California.
